newsitem.title: CHILE: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Edwards started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Edwards started as buy.

text.p: -- Santander Investment said it started coverage of Chile's Banco de A. Edwards with a buy recommendation, citing its high growth potential and undervalued share price.
-- Chile's fifth largest private bank should see strong growth in loans from its target sectors -- high-income individuals and midsize companies, said the report.

-- Santander said it believed the market overreacted to news of the bank's difficulties this year with a number of debtors, which led to a fine for exceeding individual credit limits from banking authorities.
-- "We believe that the market overreacted to negative news which led to a 20.6 percent fall in the price from mid-July 1996, providing a buy opportunity," said the report.
-- Despite these problems, the bank's past-due loan ratio is among the lowest in Chile's financial system, it said.
-- Santander's 12-18 month target price for the bank's American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) is $22.50. Banco Edwards ADRs were up 1/4 at 19-5/8 mid-afternoon Thursday.
